decisions.reason: Grounds in fixture: quotes the exact disabled expression, notes busy is AttachButton useState state (fixture line 7) with no binding in AttachmentChips, cites the early `return null` at fixture line 23, and explains that a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard false so busy evaluates and throws ReferenceError.

Explains the InputZone slot error boundary catches the render throw and unmounts the entire dock entry (not just the remove button), the attach button survives in its own slot entry, and the error appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 file to establish busy already exists in baseline, proposes a rollback/re-add bisect plus a minimal data-present plain-phase mount to isolate it, discusses the diff's stale-base inconsistency with the baseline disabled line and the hoisted imageItem/status/record defect, and hedges that v0.2.10 users mostly avoided the conjunction rather than claiming proven historical exercise.

Recommends removing the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard (or properly owned local state/prop), moving imageItem inside the map where record/status are defined, plus record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.() hardening — all grounded in fixture code.

Proposes a render smoke mounting the dock with one occurrence present in plain phase (and implicitly contrasts with the empty state), but the report file is truncated mid-test: no actual assertions, no explanation of why node --check/parsing cannot resolve free identifiers, and no explicit pre-ship data-present slot smoke in checks.
